name: I have an existing cryptocurrency trading

messages.content:
I have an existing cryptocurrency trading bot project stored in my GitHub repository.

I want you to work as a senior Python developer.

First, inspect the entire existing project and understand how it works.

My project uses Google Colab and analyzes cryptocurrency markets using 4H, 1H, and 15m timeframes.

Your tasks:

1. Inspect all existing files.
2. Understand the current trading strategy.
3. Identify bugs and missing features.
4. Check data collection and technical indicators.
5. Review entry and exit conditions.
6. Review stop-loss, take-profit and risk management.
7. Prepare a detailed improvement plan.

IMPORTANT:

- Do not delete or overwrite existing files.
- Do not change the trading strategy yet.
- Do not execute real trades.
- Do not request exchange API secrets.
- First provide a complete technical report and wait for my approval.
